title: Experimental method of determining extracting agent for oxytetracycline residue in earthworm
abstract: The invention provides an experimental method of determining an extracting agent for an oxytetracycline residue in an earthworm. The method comprises the following steps: 1) grinding an earthworm sample and Na2SO4 to prepare tissue slurry and cleaning the tissue slurry with extracting agents to obtain extract liquid; 2) carrying out stirring, oscillation, ultrasonic extraction and low-temperature high-speed centrifugation and collecting supernatant; 3) allowing the supernatant to pass through a polytetrafluoroethylene filter membrane to remove impurities and determining the content of oxytetracycline by using high performance liquid chromatography; 4) respectively calculating standard-added recovery rates of oxytetracycline by a variety of the extracting agents; and 5) subjecting a determined extracting agent to primary extraction and secondary extraction and determining an optimal scheme through variance analysis. The invention has the following advantages: through experiments, it is determined that a mixed liquor of methanol and water in a volume ratio of 4: 1 is an optimal extracting agent for extraction of the oxytetracycline residue in the earthworm; the purpose of effective extraction can be completely achieved through one extraction with the optimal extracting agent at room temperature, and the extraction needs a short period of time and low cost, is simple and easy to implement, has high extraction efficiency and is easy to popularize and apply.
